verdict.rationale: Runloop's homepage claims it can run 10k+ parallel sandboxes. Its docs describe running benchmarks at scale, with Runloop provisioning the devboxes, and executing code at scale, so large concurrent fleets are a stated first-party capability. However, the pack contains no documented concurrency limits, quotas, or per-account caps, and no independent corroboration of the fleet-scale claim. missing for 10: documented concurrency limits/quotas per account or plan, fleet-management docs (rate limits, burst behavior), independent or hands-on verification of the 10k+ parallel claim.
